answer: Each challenge is cryptographically bound, through a domain-separated hash, to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse that is unpredictable before its scheduled round and unbiasable once drand aggregates honest shares. Submissions commit before the pulse, then reveal against the derived challenge; therefore sybil swarms cannot precompute solutions or farm identities offline. An island orchard and every vine face the same late-bound randomness, while invalid or equivocal reveals are rejected.
